name: mirage
text: BK1b started: the docs-mirror workflow (api-docs.yml) is running on GitHub now. It re-downloads the Novig, ParlayAPI, Kalshi, SX Bet and Polymarket docs, and I'll diff them against the Oct 25 snapshot and tell you what changed and what the app should adopt. PropLine's docs aren't in that workflow; I'll check those separately.
